title: Pip Sees the Seed Grow
note: b418 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes ore, oor, our.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow pressing a small brown seed down into dark soil inside a glass greenhouse.
Pip the sparrow hopping up to peer closely at a small terracotta plant pot of bare soil.
A terracotta plant pot with plain, flat dark soil, Pip the sparrow looking at it closely.
A tiny pale green shoot just breaking through the surface of dark soil in a terracotta pot.
Pip the sparrow tipping a drop of water from a leaf onto the base of a small green shoot.
A thin, pale green shoot in a terracotta pot, standing a little taller than before.
Broad green leaves unfurling and spreading out from the stem of a growing plant in a terracotta pot.
A small, tightly closed green bud sitting at the very top of a plant stem.
A bright pink bloom open at the top of a plant stem in a terracotta pot inside the greenhouse.
Pip the sparrow perched on the edge of a terracotta pot, looking proudly at a bright pink bloom glowing in sunlight.
